title: guidanceContext
responsibility: Loads committed or working registry context, caches source text, resolves active identities and combines catalog declarations with contract and source hints.

inputs.name: guidanceContext.options
inputs.description: The options object: an optional project root, which defaults to process.cwd(), and optional requiredStates paths resolved against that root. The root selects the repository for the tree adapter, for loadUnits and for required-state reads; a requiredStates path that the tree's own registry scan already returned is skipped.

inputs.name: guidanceContext.committed
inputs.description: True reads the HEAD commit through CommitTreeAdapter.open(root, 'HEAD') and false reads the working tree through WorkingTreeAdapter. The choice fixes the tree for the whole context, so every later text read comes from that same tree.

inputs.name: guidanceUnit.context
inputs.description: The context returned by guidanceContext; guidanceUnit reads only its loaded.stored units and never touches the tree.

inputs.name: guidanceUnit.id
inputs.description: The exact unit id to match against stored units whose status is 'active'. Matching is strict equality, so retired units and ids that differ in case or spelling are not found and the call throws.

inputs.name: guidanceText.context
inputs.description: The context whose tree is read and whose texts map keeps each path's text. That cache lives as long as this context object, so the first stored text for a path is returned on later calls with the same context.

inputs.name: guidanceText.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path passed to context.tree.read, such as a source file a unit owns. A successful read is stored under this path in context.texts, and a rejected read is not stored.

inputs.name: scenarioStatesFor.scenario
inputs.description: The scenario manifest whose unit membership and state declarations are filtered. Its states matter when guide-unit coverage is derived: inapplicable states are dropped, explicit state unit lists take precedence, and multi-unit scenarios also require the state id to match this unit's dashed id prefix.

examples.title: Headless state coverage for the guidance context

inputs.name: scenarioStatesFor.unitId
inputs.description: The exact unit id whose membership in scenario.units determines attribution. For multi-unit scenarios it also selects states named for this unit and applies the dashed unit-id prefix rule.

inputs.name: headlessStateNames.scenarios
inputs.description: The candidate scenario manifests for state discovery. Only required states attributed to this unit by headless scenarios with no viewports count; matching UI scenario states are excluded so already-declared visual states are not reported as headless-only coverage.

inputs.name: headlessStateNames.unitId
inputs.description: The exact unit id whose scenario states are normalized and compared with registry entries when identifying headless coverage still needed for that unit.

inputs.name: headlessStateNames.registryStates
inputs.description: Catalog or required-state registry rows used to exclude states already declared for this unit. Rows for other entities do not suppress its headless state names.

inputs.name: headlessOnly.scenarios
inputs.description: The candidate scenario manifests for this unit. This matters when deciding whether the unit has at least one required, viewport-free headless state after exclusions and no attributed UI scenario state.

inputs.name: headlessOnly.unitId
inputs.description: The exact unit id used to attribute scenario states and normalize their names while deciding whether coverage for the unit is headless-only.

inputs.name: headlessOnly.registryStates
inputs.description: Existing catalog or required-state rows for the unit. A matching registry state is already declared and cannot make the unit headless-only; when omitted, the existing empty-list default is used.

inputs.name: namedUnitStates.context
inputs.description: The context whose registries and loaded.scenarios supply this unit's named states. This function is synchronous and reads nothing but registries and loaded.scenarios from the context.

inputs.name: namedUnitStates.unit
inputs.description: The stored unit whose id selects registry rows and scenario states and supplies the dashed id that unitStateName strips from state ids. Only its id is read here; its owns and contract are not used.

outputs.name: guidanceContext
outputs.description: Resolved context holding the loaded units, the selected tree, registries from stateRegistries, and new Maps for texts, testAttributions and testSyntax. It resolves only when the loader reports no errors, and every other operation in this module reads its data from this object.

errors.description: Thrown by fail() with a CLI diagnostic.

outputs.name: guidanceText
outputs.description: The text of the requested path read from the selected tree, served from context.texts when this path was already read in the same context. A rejected read propagates unchanged, and the text always comes from the context's own tree, never from the other tree.

outputs.name: namedUnitStates
outputs.description: The 'default' state followed by states from registry rows (catalog or required-states) whose entity equals this unit's id and from scenario states of scenarios that include this unit, each with origin REQUIRED and merged by name. Inapplicable states are excluded. A viewport-free headless scenario uses this unit's explicit states if present. Otherwise it uses unowned states with its dashed unit prefix, or unowned shared states without another listed unit's prefix when none are named for this unit. Other scenarios keep the named-unit attribution rule.

outputs.name: sourceUnitStates
outputs.description: Guessed states with origin GUESS, read from status, state, phase, mode or variant comparisons, from property annotations listing string literals, and from assignments to names ending in Status, State, Phase or Mode, all in the scanned source. A match that includes complete also adds succeeded, and these hints never establish rendered proof.

outputs.name: allUnitStates
outputs.description: States from named registries and scenarios, contract-derived guesses and source-branch guesses, merged by name with their reasons combined. A name keeps origin REQUIRED only when a registry or scenario declares it, so a guess is upgraded only by a named declaration.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail() with a CLI diagnostic: guidanceContext throws the joined loader errors, an unreadable required-state file or a malformed required-state JSON file, and guidanceUnit throws Unknown unit naming the requested id when no active stored unit has it.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Rejections from CommitTreeAdapter.open, loadUnits and the selected tree's entry enumeration and file reads propagate unchanged, and guidanceText, sourceUnitStates and allUnitStates inherit them through tree reads.
